text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper with primary focus on land use/cover (LULC) prediction for Romania at the national scale, using the CLUE-S model and CORINE Land Cover database. The study explicitly implements two future scenarios (based on 1990-2000 and 2000-2006 change rates) projecting LULC changes until 2050, with quantitative comparisons between scenarios. The methodology includes spatially explicit modeling at 500m resolution covering the whole country, and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Overall Accuracy, Kappa, User’s and Producer’s Accuracy). Outputs include mapped LULC projections and detailed analysis of agricultural land use flows. The scale is national (Romania), and the paper does not meet any exclusion criteria such as local/regional scale only, lack of future prediction, or absence of quantitative spatial modeling.)
